label_certificates.note: every repaired question is re-checked against the corpus with a predicate written independently of the generator, using the label standard's own notion of a definition -- a subject, a copula and an article -- applied to every sentence of the corpus rather than to one chunk. The near-miss probe counts a different thing: the questions whose subject the corpus comments on without defining it, so that a reader could sometimes construct an answer even though the label standard recognises none. That is the character of a mechanically labelled unanswerable class, and it is reported rather than hidden.
